The '''Mandalorian Seeker''' armor was a advanced type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that grew in popularity with [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian soldiers]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and various others during the near end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] before becoming one of the primary armorsets used by the warrior clans in the [[Galactic War]] and the [[war against Zakuul]] alongside the [[TT-17A Hydra]] and the [[Mandalorian Hunter armor|Mandalorian Hunter]] armorsets.
